Rally's tvOS playback path uses KSPlayer 2.3.4 and FFmpegKit 6.1.4.
The pinned public package versions currently use GNU GPL version 3. Their full
license texts are included in KSPlayer-GPL.txt and FFmpegKit-GPL.txt.

KSPlayer source: https://github.com/kingslay/KSPlayer/tree/2.3.4
FFmpegKit source: https://github.com/kingslay/FFmpegKit/tree/6.1.4

This dependency configuration must not be distributed as part of a Rally
proprietary app unless Rally has secured compatible licensing or changed its
distribution/licensing terms. Do not describe this build as LGPL licensed.
